A young inmate (Kyle Chandler) gets himself assigned to the prison ranch, run by a former rodeo champ (Jon Voight), and is set on competing at the prison rodeo. But when a drug runner interferes, he ends up in far more danger than bull riding!
When Russia's first nuclear submarine malfunctions on its maiden voyage, the crew must race to save the ship and prevent a nuclear disaster.

Jeff Bridges and Tommy Lee Jones team up for this action-filled, edge-of-your-seat thriller about a mad bomber terrorizing Boston. Forest Whitaker and Lloyd Bridges co-star.

Yul Brynner stars as a powerful Cossack chieftain determined to regain his land from Polish invaders. But conflict erupts when his son (Tony Curtis) falls deeply in love with a Polish girl. Spectacular battle scenes highlight the nonstop action!

In Stanley Kramer's cinema classic, screen legends Sidney Poitier and Tony Curtis star as two convicts on the run from a Southern work gang who are bound together by an unbreakable iron chain and separated by an unbridled hatred for each other.
